title: Bigger than Rhode Island
text: Naval Air Weapons Station China Lake covers more than 1.1 million acres, an area larger than the state of Rhode Island. It is the Navy's largest single landholding. The part of the base inside Kern County is about 1.4 percent of the county, as of 2024.
